taken as written

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

clue.text: American author in family group on Cyprus

explanation.surface: A US novelist is part of a family living on Cyprus.

clue.text: Dead — unlike Pluto, for example

definitions.meaning: Pluto is Disney's animated cartoon dog, so something not like him is not a cartoon

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both lifeless and, punningly, not drawn as a cartoon like Disney's dog.

clue.text: Warlord executed for treason

parts.note: read 'Warlord' as 'war lord': a lord of the Second World War, namely the nickname of the Nazi radio propagandist hanged as a traitor in 1946

explanation.surface: A military strongman is put to death for betraying his country.
explanation.walkthrough: William Joyce broadcast Nazi propaganda to Britain and was nicknamed Lord Haw-Haw for his drawling, mocking accent; he was hanged for treason in 1946. The clue splits 'warlord' into a lord of the war.
explanation.definitionFit: The propagandist William Joyce was known by this nickname, a lord of wartime radio, and was executed for treason.

clue.text: Short dress a friend put on in sheikdom

explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' cuts the last letter from HABIT to give HABI.
explanation.definitionFit: Abu Dhabi is one of the United Arab Emirates, ruled by a sheikh, so a sheikdom.

clue.text: One police force intervening in domestic crime

explanation.definitionFit: Homicide is the killing of one person by another, a crime.

clue.text: Bias isn't commonly seen in cosmetic treatment

clue.text: A fish swallowing a scrap, something got from seaweed

clue.text: "Tea For Two" as dance music

explanation.definitionFit: The cha-cha is a Latin American ballroom dance, and also the music played for it.

clue.text: Formerly altered three, zero and four, say

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Altered' turns THREE plus O into HERETO; 'say' makes four into its sound-alike FORE.
explanation.definitionFit: Heretofore is a formal word for before now, so formerly.

clue.text: Take special note, having originally ordered port in spa

explanation.walkthrough: 'Having originally' places the word for ordered at the start, ahead of NB and the port.
explanation.definitionFit: Baden-Baden is a famous German spa town in the Black Forest, so it is an example of a spa.

clue.text: Isn't switching partners in court natural behaviour?

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Switching partners' swaps the S and N of ISNT to give INST.
explanation.definitionFit: Instinct is innate, unlearned behaviour, so natural behaviour.

clue.text: Frightens girl in love with boy
